messages:
sam: Quick brain dump: prototyping a 'Query Path Cost' view that tries to capture not just immediate token spend but also amortized warmup / prefetch costs that certain SKUs incur. Want feedback on telemetry fields and how we present 'amortized warmup' vs per-invocation cost.

felix: Interesting. How do you define warmup cost? Is it GPU memory warm-up, KV-cache population, or prefetch work that benefits later requests? We need a clear math model.

meera: UX: users will be confused if two numbers appear (amortized vs direct). Maybe show primary "per-invocation token cost" and a collapsible line for "amortized warmup & prefetch credits" with a short explainer.

sam: Warmup = one-time or rare prefetch/amortization that benefits N subsequent queries. Model it as: amortized_cost = total_prefetch_tokens / expected_reuse_window. We'll include reuse_window as an adjustable parameter in the UI.

	
	tara: Telemetry-wise we need to emit: qpath_id, route, chosen_sku, prefetch_tokens, prefetch_key (hash list), tokens_in, tokens_out, cache_hit, reuse_hint (optional), fallback_info. For privacy, prefetch_key must be hashed/redacted.

felix: Implementation idea: keep per-request event tiny (qpath_id + tokens_in + final_sku + cache_hit) and ship a separate prefetch_event when prefetch runs with prefetch_tokens + prefetch_key_hash + ttl_reuse_estimate. That way we can join offline to compute amortization.

meera: For the panel: show route-level heatmap with two layers: top = per-invocation spend, bottom (semi-transparent) = amortized warmup overlay. Hover shows a breakdown: direct tokens, amortized_pretech, net effective unit cost.

billing-bot: billing: CSV export required for audits. Must include immutable rows with reconciliation_id, qpath_id, billed_sku, direct_tokens, amortized_tokens, amortized_method, confidence_pct. Exports must be reproducible (i.e., include calculation params used).

sam: Good point on reproducibility. We'll make exports include export_metadata: {"amortization_window_days": "X", "sample_method": "reservoir"} as plain columns.

felix: Caution: adding prefetch events increases cardinality and index load. Do we keep prefetch events in a compact table and only materialize joins for export/time-range queries?

	
	tara: Also think about canary/rollout: when routing policy changes, amortized credits need to be re-apportioned or flagged as "stale". UX should label numbers that might change post-rollout.

meera: UX idea for that: show a small "stale" icon and a tooltip: "This amortized number depends on historical reuse patterns and may change after routing/sku updates. Click to recompute with new policy simulation."

felix: Simulation widget: allow sliding reuse_window (how many subsequent requests you expect to benefit) and routing split between SKUs. Show live recalculation of amortized cost and projected monthly delta. Provide an option to "recompute using entire history" vs "recent sample (7d)".

billing-bot: billing: exports should also include a boolean "immutable_snapshot" column. If true, the export must be stored and later queries against the same reconciliation_id should yield identical numbers. Useful for audits.

sam: We'll implement two export modes: "dynamic" (live estimates) and "snapshot" (immutable, stores parameters and computed values). Snapshot will cost more and be admin-only.

felix: Telemetry contract sketch: required per-request fields: qpath_id, tokens_in. Optional: final_sku, cache_hit, fallback_reason. Prefetch events: prefetch_id, qpath_id, prefetch_tokens, prefetch_key_hash, created_at, ttl_seconds, reuse_hint.

meera: For customers, default to hiding amortized warmup and showing only per-invocation billed tokens. Internal staff get a toggle to expose amortized details and apportioned allocations.

	
	ops-bot: deploy-bot: new telemetry schema "querypath-amort-v1" staged to canary 'canary-chi' in 2m :rocket:

	
	tara: One more: quota interactions. If quota limits cause failovers to cheaper SKUs, the amortized credits shouldn't be double-counted. Telemetry should capture 'routing_cause' (e.g., capacity_cutover, quota_hit, manual_override).

felix: Good call. We'll add routing_cause as an optional enum. Also mark prefetch events with origin_sku so we know which SKU paid the prefetch.

billing-bot: billing: CSV note: include "origin_sku" for prefetch rows so finance can attribute the initial warmup spend to the right charge bucket.

sam: I'll write a short RFC: telemetry contract, amortization formula, export/snapshot semantics, and UI wireframes with simulation knobs. Will call out privacy constraints for prefetch keys.

meera: Love it. Small request: in the UI, offer a "why did this number change?" drilldown that lists recent routing/policy events that affected amortization calculations.

felix: I'll prototype the ingestion shim that materializes prefetch events and exposes a compact join endpoint for exports.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary 'canary-chi' reports schema healthy in 3m :white_check_mark:

sam: Thanks all. If no objections I'll land RFC tomorrow and start telemetry PR.

tara: +1

meera: +1

felix: +1

billing-bot: billing: noted for audit workflow.
